subject.title: Dashboard: new data-binding kinds — stream, command, computed

question: Should the dashboard binding roadmap include allowlisted periodic command execution, or should command bindings be split into a separate security-reviewed design after stream and computed bindings?
rationale: Automation cannot choose the product and security boundary for running commands from dashboard data resolution, and the underlying dashboard substrate is still an open PR stack rather than current main.

options.title: Split Command Security Design
options.body: Proceed with stream and computed binding design only after the dashboard substrate lands, and require a separate maintainer-approved proposal for command execution.

options.title: Approve All Binding Kinds Together
options.body: Allow stream, computed, and command bindings in one feature, with implementation carrying the full allowlist, permission, audit, and proof burden.

options.title: Defer Dashboard Apps Layer
options.body: Keep the roadmap item open but pause implementation until maintainers decide whether the modular dashboard apps layer belongs in bundled OpenClaw.

recommendation.title: Split Command Security Design
recommendation.body: Proceed with stream and computed binding design only after the dashboard substrate lands, and require a separate maintainer-approved proposal for command execution.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main history signal is the recently landed Control UI plugin-tab seam and Logbook precedent that this dashboard stack reuses.
